title: Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) and Salesforce.com on Monday announced a new enterprise partnership
text:
September 24, 2018 Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) and Salesforce.com on Monday announced a new enterprise partnership
Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) and Salesforce.com on Monday announced a new enterprise partnership that will make it easier for iOS developers to design for Salesforce.
Salesforce said that it would resign its app to add new exclusive iOS features , ahead of the Salesforce Dreamforce conference. There will also be a new iOS app development course on Salesforce’s educational Trailhead platform that will help Salesforce developers better operate in Apple’s ecosystem.
